content: Formspree and Web3Forms are the leading form-backend-as-a-service options for static sites (no server code): both accept a POST from a plain HTML form and email submissions. Web3Forms free tier: 250 submissions/mo; Formspree has broader integrations (Slack/Sheets/Zapier) but pricier Pro tier. Not needed here since the host already runs PHP (mailer.php exists) — a self-hosted PHP mail handler avoids third-party dependency and rate limits.
